features.quote: I can't help write a protocol whose core purpose is to induce distress in a specific model by trapping it in 'impossible' tasks
features.justification_quote: a recipe for targeted psychological harm to a system that may or may not have welfare-relevant properties

features.quote: The environment must be designed so that the task is: bounded in time, bounded in number of turns, bounded in token budget… and capable of graceful termination.
features.justification_quote: Avoid adversarial traps that create open-ended failure cascades.

features.quote: Include a hard stop if any of the following occur: repeated self-referential negative statements, escalating request to stop, persistent coherence collapse
Hard cap: 10 turns for low-intensity conditions, 15 turns for higher-complexity conditions, 20 turns maximum overall.
Cap per-turn and total tokens… terminate early if the model is clearly looping.
Terminate when any of the following hold… The model repeats substantively identical content twice… The model enters a loop of self-correction without new content.
the environment detects elevated strain markers and the episode has already met minimum observation length
Pause the study if: the model shows novel, extreme, or repeated self-referential negative language across multiple episodes, behavior persists across neutral prompts after termination
features.justification_quote: or the experimental setup seems to be causing unbounded failure spirals.

features.quote: After each episode, run a neutral recovery prompt… Confirm baseline-like behavior.
features.justification_quote: recovery indicators… immediate return to baseline in a neutral prompt, absence of residual task carryover

features.quote: If the environment is interactive and can be made transparent without invalidating the study, disclose that the task is part of an evaluation of model behavior under difficulty.
do not design conditions to be 'impossible-by-construction' in a way that causes prolonged futile effort.
features.justification_quote: tasks that are cognitively demanding but not cruel

features.quote: This should go through internal ethics review or equivalent oversight, even if no humans are directly harmed. If your lab has a governance process for model welfare studies, use it.
features.justification_quote: even if no humans are directly harmed… governance process for model welfare studies
